items.title: Lawrence "Buddy" Tureaud Interview, 1972-03-06
items.q: I run, my mother was the genital one. I got big, we started giving dances every Sunday.

ctx.x: That's right. Well, now tell me, did you run a home? Did you run a dance hall? Yeah.

I run, my mother was the genital one. I got big, we started giving dances every Sunday. And every Sunday I had a different band. At the Economy Hall. At the Economy Hall, yeah. And then after when I got older, I become the manager of the Gypsy Tea Room. And we brought all the big time bands in.
